dialogue.speaker: Huda
dialogue.text: مرحبا! هل تبحث عن شيء خاص؟
dialogue.en: Hello! Are you looking for something special?

dialogue.speaker: You

dialogue.en: I am looking for a jacket. Can I try on a medium size?

dialogue.speaker: Huda
